name: 8a-PDHQ
summary: 8a-Phenyldecahydroquinoline (8A-PDHQ) is a high affinity NMDA antagonist developed by a team at Parke Davis in the 1950s. It is a structural analog of phencyclidine with slightly lower binding affinity than the parent compound. (−)-8a-Phenyldecahydroquinoline has an in vivo potency comparable to that of (+)-MK-801.

pharmacology.text: 8a-Phenyldecahydroquinoline (8A-PDHQ) is a high affinity NMDA antagonist developed by a team at Parke Davis in the 1950s. It is a structural analog of phencyclidine with slightly lower binding affinity than the parent compound.

summaryZh: 8A-PDHQ是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C15H21N，可作為NMDA受體拮抗劑，1950年代由Parke-Davis開發。
summaryZhHans: 8A-PDHQ是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C15H21N，可作为NMDA受体拮抗剂，1950年代由Parke-Davis开发。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the arylcyclohexylamines such as PCP and ketamine, can cause confusion, dissociation, loss of coordination, numbness, a faster heartbeat and raised blood pressure. Serious risks include agitation, psychosis, dangerous accidents while impaired and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的芳基環己胺類藥物（例如PCP與K他命），可能引起意識混亂、解離、協調變差、麻木、心跳加快與血壓升高。嚴重風險包括躁動、精神病、在失能狀態下發生危險意外，以及成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的芳基环己胺类药物（例如PCP与K他命），可能引起意识混乱、解离、协调制差、麻木、心跳加快与血压升高。严重风险包括躁动、精神病、在失能状态下发生危险意外，以及成瘾。

fact.en: A team at Parke-Davis made it in the 1950s, in the same programme that produced PCP. Its rings are fully saturated, so it has no flat aromatic ring at all where PCP has one.
fact.zh: Parke-Davis的團隊在1950年代合成了它，而同一個研究計畫也產生了PCP。它的環完全飽和，因此在PCP帶有平面芳香環的位置上，它完全沒有這樣的環。
fact.zhHans: Parke-Davis的团队在1950年代合成了它，而同一个研究计划也产生了PCP。它的环完全饱和，因此在PCP带有平面芳香环的位置上，它完全没有这样的环。
